<!-- pr-reviewer: b3107a5fe272ba6d4e1a2f9e862870b01dfe634f -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The fix is right. Two of its safety claims have no pin: the setup-frame transform, and the refusal when no part is left. Each needs one small test. Everything else checks out.

### What looks good
- `setup_align::part_aabb_in` uses the same part set as `setup_align::is_part` and the program sim's `parts_facets_in` (any `FixtureDef`, of any setup, is left out). `FixtureDef` has a single setup binding, so a model that is a fixture in Setup 2 is never a part anywhere. That matches how the sim and the collision gate already split parts from fixtures. Excluding a fixture of *any* setup is the right reading of #1529's "a fixture placed in setup B never changes setup A's heights".
- The change is small. `TopOfModel` / `BottomOfModel` and their `missing_source` read the new set. `is_model`, `solid_aabb_in`, `fixture::tagged` and the collision laws are untouched. No `unwrap`/`expect` was added. The test file carries provenance and a gate map. The decision file is present. The `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #1529` are there. No process files were touched and `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited. No `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot or golden changes.
- The 5 pins are well aimed. The two mutations the PR reports reproduce here (below).

### Local results (trial-merged with upstream main 9085636, macOS arm64, sccache)
Merge: clean, no conflicts. Build: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` ok.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| heights_fixtures (new) | 5 passed |
| app lib | 194 passed |
| heights | 11 passed |
| heights_selection | 9 passed |
| setup_align | 10 passed |
| setup_carry | 9 passed |
| fixture_locate_stock | 3 passed |
| stock_source_verdict | 22 passed |
| turning / turning_blade / turning_profile | 6 / 14 / 6 passed |
| fixtures / builtin_vise / builtin_accessory / fixture_plate | 14 / 9 / 3 / 7 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| golden_cl | 32 passed (goldens unchanged) |
| verify | 21 passed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

camcraft-ui was not built: the diff touches no UI code, and the "no model loaded" text its echo test reads is unchanged.

**Mutation checks** (each one applied alone, then reverted):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Drop the filter (`part_aabb_in` keeps every model) | all 5 pins red |
| Filter by the wrong setup (leave out only `fixture::tagged(world, declared)`) | `a_vise_declared_in_setup_two_does_not_move_setup_ones_heights` red |
| Drop the frame transform (`models_aabb_in` reads `model::world_facets`, not `facets_in`) | **survives**: heights_fixtures, setup_align, heights, heights_selection, setup_carry, stock_source_verdict and app lib all green |
| Drop the resolved-Z stamp input (`stamp_with`) | the 5 pins stay green; caught by the existing `heights` suite and `operation::heights_sel` lib test |
| Revert `missing_source` to `model::solid_world_aabb` | **survives**: all green |

Local probes (not pushed), all behaving correctly on this head:
- With only fixtures left, both references resolve to `None`. Generate refuses with `Top of Part Z (From: model top, offset 0) is unresolved: no model loaded`. There is no fallback to the vise.
- An empty document gives `None` with "no model loaded".
- Tagging a body under the part makes the op Stale. Undo restores Bottom of Model (-60) and the op reads Ok again. Untag after regenerate makes it Stale again.
- Default contour plus vise under the part, in the same setup or in Setup 2: generate is ok and `verification_gate` is empty, so generate and post now agree.
- Setup tilted 90 degrees about X (`AlignPartToSetup::angles`), plus a vise: the references are Z -18..32, the part on its side.

### Requested before merge
1. **Pin the setup-frame transform.** Add this to `crates/app/tests/heights_fixtures.rs`. The PR claims the heights read "in the asking setup's frame (the #326 alignment still applies)", but no suite in the app goes red when `models_aabb_in` drops it. The presets (flips, Z turns about the part's centre) leave the Z span unchanged, so only a tilt shows it. The test is ten lines and it kills the mutation here:
   ```rust
   h.execute(&world, CreateSetup::new(&world, None, None).expect("Setup1"));
   h.execute(&world, AlignPartToSetup::angles(&world, "Setup1", [90.0, 0.0, 0.0]).expect("align"));
   let tilted = model_refs(&world, Some("Setup1"));
   vise_below(&world, &mut h, Some("Setup1"));
   assert_eq!(model_refs(&world, Some("Setup1")), tilted);
   // the 50 mm side now stands up: top - bottom == 50 (Z -18..32 here), not 4..10
   ```
2. **Pin the no-part refusal.** Same file. Use a document whose only models are fixtures, for example `TagFixture` on `block` plus a vise. Assert that both references resolve to `None`, that `missing_source(.., TopOfModel)` is `Some("no model loaded")`, and that `GenerateOperation::new` errs with `unresolved: no model loaded`. A later change that falls back to `solid_aabb_in` when no part is left would put the vise heights straight back, and nothing would catch it today. This pin also covers the `missing_source` change, which survives mutation now.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- **Other model-bounds readers that still include fixtures:**
  - UI stock fit and the stock info strip: `crates/ui/src/state.rs:3059`, `:3071`, `:3089` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/stock_info.rs:13`. These are already filed as #1538.
  - The WCS pane's "model bounds" anchor: `crates/ui/src/interact.rs:297` `anchor_reference` reads `solid_aabb_in`. With a vise placed, G54 lands on the vise's corner. This is not in #1538. Could it be added there, or filed on its own?
  - The camera/view extents (`interact.rs:428`, `:1038`, `:1611`) only frame the view and are fine.
  - Selection references read the op's own source, so they are unaffected.
- **Stock-source model (#1094).** The issue's "Expected" names the stock-source model too. The decision file explains why it was left out, but no follow-up issue exists. A larger raw-casting model still sets Bottom of Model below the part. Please file it, or note it on #1094.
- **Untagged imported workholding** (a vise body imported as a mesh and never tagged) still counts as the part. That matches the design, where the tag is what makes it a fixture. The "no model loaded" message may confuse someone who has a vise loaded but no part. "no part model loaded (fixtures do not count)" would say why. Optional.
- Optional: assert `posting::verification_gate(&world).is_empty()` in the first pin. That makes "generate ok, post ok" an explicit pin, not only implied by the path matching the bare one.
- File sizes: `operation/heights.rs` was already over 400 lines and grows by 3 to 441. `setup_align.rs` goes from 390 to 404. Worth a split next time either file is touched.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
